tooltips.reference: This is the automation's unique name. It can't be renamed here; ask your agent to recreate it with a new name or use BuilderBot web.
tooltips.source: Source is the tool that sends events to this automation. It can't be changed in place; create a new triggered automation to use a different source.

triggerType.label: Explain trigger type
triggerType.scheduled: Scheduled automations run at a time you choose. To make this event-based instead, ask your agent to recreate it or use BuilderBot web.
triggerType.routing: Triggered automations run when something happens in another tool. To make this schedule-based instead, ask your agent to recreate it or use BuilderBot web.

actionType.label: Explain action type
actionType.agent: Agent automations run non-deterministically through an agent. The other option is Script. To change this, ask your agent or use BuilderBot web.
actionType.script: Script automations run a defined command. The other option is Agent, which runs non-deterministically through an agent. To change this, ask your agent or use BuilderBot web.
actionType.routine: This automation runs a custom routine. To change it to Agent or Script, ask your agent or use BuilderBot web.
actionType.task: This automation creates a BuilderBot task instead of running Agent or Script. To change this, ask your agent or use BuilderBot web.
